title: /reload-plugins drops the worker list: stop, message and the sidebar lose all running workers
body:
## Expected
After `/reload-plugins`, the coordinator keeps its running workers. `hooks/state.ts` and the comment in `hooks/workers.ts` ("the jobs live in $.state, so session.start re-attaches a watcher to each running one") say that a reload keeps the jobs.

## Actual
After `/reload-plugins` (then `/hrd-side`, `/hrd-orchestrate`), the jobs list is empty:
- `stop` and `message` return `no worker <name>` for each of the 9 workers that ran.
- The sidebar shows `0 busy` and "No workers yet.", but the worker tabs are still open and working in herdr.
- No watcher runs, so no report arrives: one worker wrote RESULT.md, and three wrote WAIT.json for CI. The mod picked up none of these.

## Effect
The coordinator cannot reach its workers. Recovery: close each worker tab with `herdr tab close`, then spawn new workers in the same worktrees to continue the work.

## Repro
1. Spawn some workers with `spawn`.
2. Run `/reload-plugins` while they work.
3. Call `stop` on one worker: the result is `no worker <name>`. The sidebar shows no workers.

## Possible directions
- Check that `$.state` atoms persist over a plugin reload, or save the jobs to a file in the session dir.
- Optionally, add a re-adopt step: on `session.start`, find herdr tabs with a known worker name and a job folder, and rebuild their jobs.

Version: mod at f9f3201.

comments.body: Related, same session after the reload: `spawn` and `stop` work again, but `message` fails with: "herdr-agents registered the tool message but no tool.call hook answered this call: add on(\"tool.call\", { tool: \"mcp__herdr-agents__message\" }, ...) to the plugin." Workaround: `herdr agent prompt <pane> "<text>"`.

Case 2026-10-23: the gh token became invalid, and all 7 worker Claude sessions ended (the panes showed a bare shell). After that, stop said "no worker <name>" for all 7. The mod had lost the jobs, and no idle or done report came. Recovery: I closed the panes with herdr pane close and spawned new workers under new names.
